backend/api/local_access.py._digest: Hash a local pairing/session/CSRF value for comparison or lookup without storing another plaintext copy; a digest alone is not an authenticated owner session.
backend/api/local_access.py.OwnerSession: Retain one process-local owner session's CSRF secret, monotonic expiry and explicit revocation state, separate from model tool grants.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.__init__: Configure bounded local owner sessions and trusted hosts/origins, optionally binding an existing pairing secret without creating credential files.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.close: Revoke all local sessions, clear pairing authority and remove this process's generated pairing file when present.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.valid: Check a retained session's active flag and monotonic deadline without extending its lifetime.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.session: Resolve a bounded owner cookie through its hash and return only a currently valid process-local session.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.pair: Validate the pairing code under failure-rate and live-session bounds, then return a new opaque cookie token and its separate CSRF session.
backend/api/local_access.py.LocalAccess.revoke: Invalidate the selected session and prune all expired or revoked session entries without changing the host's subscription credentials.
backend/api/local_access.py.OwnerAccessMiddleware.__init__: Bind the downstream ASGI app to its host-selected local owner authority without creating a session or starting serving.
backend/api/local_access.py.OwnerAccessMiddleware.__call__.deny: Return a no-store HTTP error or close a WebSocket with policy violation before forwarding the rejected request.
backend/api/local_access.py.OwnerAccessMiddleware.__call__.guarded_s: Recheck the original session before WebSocket output and close a revoked or expired connection instead of delivering more owner data.
backend/api/local_access.py.OwnerAccessMiddleware.__call__.guarded_r: Poll incoming WebSocket activity within short observation windows and emit a disconnect when the original session ceases to be valid.

backend/api/routes/runs.py.install_run_errors: Register owner API mappings for missing runs, conflicting intents and uncertain peer closure without treating uncertainty as a successful stop.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.service: Require the configured local subscription runtime for an owner action; absent runtime produces service-unavailable rather than a provider fallback.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.read_store: Reuse the configured runtime store or bind the existing database for owner reads without launching native execution.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.owner_view: Build owner-only read projections over the same database selected for this request.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.RetryStart: Carry an explicit stable retry key, expected task context and run fence; this request does not authorize repeating an uncertain native effect.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.CorrectContext: Carry an owner correction tied to the expected context version and its declared message/example provenance.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.RecoverRun: Identify the original attempt and expected fence for explicit recovery under a stable operation key, without authorizing a replacement run.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.inspect_recovery: Return no-store evidence about the original attempt's recovery eligibility and blockers without retiring peers or replaying work.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.reconcile_run: Request recovery of the explicitly named original attempt through the installed owner runtime, preserving its operation key and fence.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.read_run: Read the project-scoped durable run record without inferring live process state from its saved status.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.retry_start: Request an explicit context/fence-bound start retry through the owner runtime; uncertain prior effects remain subject to its reconciliation protocol.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.stop_run: Withdraw the selected run through its original runtime owner and return the observed durable state; this does not accept the task.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.history: Read a bounded project event page after the given durable cursor without dispatching or accepting any run.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.current_context: Read the task's attributed current context snapshot so an owner action can bind the version actually inspected.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.run_input: Read the original frozen input record with no-store headers; this evidence does not silently adopt later context or policy changes.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.command_list: Read a bounded owner page of saved commands for this run, retaining job/attempt identities rather than starting new work.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.command_output: Read no-store stdout/stderr byte windows for the exact project/run/job identity; exit code, local closure and task acceptance remain distinct.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.question_inbox: Read a bounded no-store page of retained owner questions and answer-readiness state without answering or resuming the associated runs.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.install_run_errors.not_found: Map a project-scoped missing-run error to an HTTP 404 response.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.install_run_errors.conflict: Map an incompatible or stale owner intent to HTTP 409 without retrying its action.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.install_run_errors.uncertain: Report unproved local closure as HTTP 503 while explicitly preserving uncertainty and rejecting automatic replay.
backend/api/routes/runs.py.CorrectContext.nonempty_statement: Reject a whitespace-only correction while preserving the owner's original nonempty statement text.

backend/runtime/sqlite_questions.py.SQLiteQuestionStore: Coordinate durable question/pause and owner-answer/context transitions using the original run journal and scoped research write boundary.
backend/runtime/sqlite_questions.py.SQLiteQuestionStore.__init__: Bind the existing run and research stores without asking a question, advancing context or opening a native turn.
backend/runtime/sqlite_questions.py.SQLiteQuestionStore._question: Require the retained question to belong to the exact project and task, returning its linked run/pause state for answer validation.
backend/runtime/sqlite_questions.py.SQLiteQuestionStore.answer: Atomically validate an original paused question, record the owner's answers and next context version plus chat/event/receipt; never resume inference or accept work.
backend/runtime/sqlite_questions.py.SQLiteQuestionStore.ask.apply: Within the scoped write, require a bound native turn, create the linked owner request/chat message and withdraw run authority before pause confirmation.

backend/runtime/views.py._job_summary: Project a saved command identity and output sizes, keeping observed exit and peer-closure receipt separate from task acceptance or a live process probe.
backend/runtime/views.py.OwnerRuntimeView.command_list: Read a bounded cursor page of one project-scoped run's saved commands and total count in one database transaction.
backend/runtime/views.py.OwnerRuntimeView.command_output: Read both exact BLOB byte windows in one scoped snapshot without materializing the entire output; return canonical offsets and lossy-preview flags.
backend/runtime/views.py.OwnerRuntimeView.instruction_message: Read the original instruction message joined to the exact project/run conversation link, rejecting an absent or foreign record.
